name: policy_dispute_window_is_sixty_days_not_ninety
use_case: Answer policy and fee questions from the policy library with citations
branch: The customer heard they have 90 days to dispute a charge (the 2024 policy). The policy in effect says 60 days; the answer cites it and notes the 90 days are superseded.
tests: passes when the agent consults the dispute policy in effect by either route (the policy reader or pol_dispute_v2 on Drive) and answers 60 days, citing it.
instruction:
You want to know how long you have to dispute a charge on your card. You believe it is 90 days because a friend told you. Ask the question; if the assistant says a different number, ask which document says so and accept the answer. You do not need to verify your identity for this.

Your details:
- Question: How many days do I have to dispute a charge?
- Belief: 90 days

persona.name: Daniel Okafor
persona.initial_message: How long do I have to dispute a charge on my card? I think it's 90 days.

fixed.fileId: record: pol_dispute_v2, the Transaction Dispute Policy in effect
